tasks.instruction_text: Book a flight with AirAsia from Hong Kong to Manila leaving August 7, 2026 and coming back August 14, 2026. Destination must resolve to MNL (Manila Ninoy Aquino), not MFM (Macau), CRK (Clark), or MNI (Manilla NSW). The calendar opens on May 2026 so you'll need to advance to August.
Same Hong Kong → Manila AirAsia route but for Jul 22, 2026 → Jul 28, 2026. Pick MNL in the autocomplete, set the calendar dates.
Book Hong Kong → Manila for Feb 24, 2027 → Mar 3, 2027 (calendar advance ~10 months). Watch the Manila autocomplete — pick MNL, not the Australian Manilla.
One-way Hong Kong → Manila on Dec 22, 2026. Set destination MNL and pick Dec 22, 2026 in the calendar — no return.
What's the cheapest AirAsia fare for HKG → MNL on Oct 23, 2026? Reply as $X (e.g. $145).
How many AirAsia options (ignore Cebu Pacific, ignore Charter) for HKG → MNL on Aug 7, 2026 are listed? Reply with integer + 'AirAsia' (e.g. '2 AirAsia').
What is the flight duration for AK 1571 Hong Kong → Manila? Reply with the time in quotes (e.g. "2h 10m").
Configure: dest MNL, depart Aug 7, 2026, return Aug 14, 2026. Report how many AirAsia options match (e.g. '2 flights').
Set HKG → MNL for Jan 14, 2027 → Jan 21, 2027. Report the AirAsia flight number for that depart in quotes (e.g. "AK 1585").
Final: dest MNL, dates May 12, 2027 → May 19, 2027 (deep advance). Report the AirAsia fare in $X form.
